provenance.source_citation: Summative proficient cut. ISTEP / ISTEP+ reported three achievement levels (Did Not Pass / Pass / Pass +); the maintainer confirms (2026-09-02) that the Level 1 / Level 2 boundary -- the Pass cut -- was the proficient cut and the accountability target for that era. basis=proficiency_boundary derives it from the assessment record's cutscores and its achievement_levels proficient_from ('Pass'), introducing no new numbers; the target inherits that record's cutscores provenance.
